'''Killer Bees''' is a modern Star Wars CCG playtest team. A 2026 GEMPC bracket-reveal stream named it alongside [[New Allies]], [[Team 5]], and Money Ball as one of the standing teams the Council considered when seeding, calling it "the best up and coming team."<ref name="gempc-br">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rA539EIuVm0 2026 GEMPC bracket reveal], Star Wars CCG YouTube</ref> A 2026 U.S. Nationals stream remarked that "100% of the Killer Bees are on Luke Saga."<ref name="nats-stream">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7jJnb8oZBTU 2026 U.S. Nationals Game 1], Star Wars CCG YouTube</ref>
